name: Silver Stream Mine
summary: In northern Loch Modan, Silver Stream Mine lies between Algaz Station and the Stonewrought Dam. Its silver veins are spent, and Tunnel Rat kobolds now hoard stolen equipment and rare minerals in the Miners' League depot.

sections.title: From Rich Vein to Storage Depot
sections.body: Silver Stream Mine once sent rich silver to Ironforge. Dwarf miners worked its veins until they ran dry, leaving broad chambers beneath the earth. The Miners' League put those hard-won shafts to use as a guarded storehouse for tools, mining crates, and regional equipment. The mine also yields Charged Rift Gems, which draw arcanists seeking delicate tailoring reagents.

sections.title: The Kobold Incursion
sections.body: Tunnel Rat kobolds came in great numbers and drove the Miners' League caretakers out into the cold of Loch Modan. Now they guard the stolen dwarf crates with manic fervor. Beyond the rear entrances, shattered orcish catapults and wagons lie forgotten, remnants of older frontier skirmishes.

faq.q: What was the Silver Stream Mine originally used for?
faq.answer: Dwarves of Ironforge first worked Silver Stream Mine for its rich silver. When the veins ran dry, the Ironforge Miners' League turned its empty halls into a depot for tools and mining supplies.

aliases: who lives in silver stream mine
what is inside silver stream mine
faq.answer: Tunnel Rat kobolds occupy Silver Stream Mine. They drove out the dwarf caretakers and now guard the League crates, hoarding supplies and digging for what remains.

faq.q: Why do mages travel to Silver Stream Mine?
faq.answer: Charged Rift Gems come only from Silver Stream Mine. Alliance arcanists seek them to weave enchanted robes.

faq.q: What are the ruined catapults behind the mine?
faq.answer: Broken orcish wagons and ruined catapults lie behind Silver Stream Mine. They remain from earlier wartime conflicts that threatened the passages between Loch Modan and the northern mountain passes.

angles.text: For dwarves, Silver Stream Mine is Ironforge work now lost to clumsy kobolds, who sully a respectable Miners' League depot.
As an apprentice mage, you brave the kobold-infested tunnels for Charged Rift Gems, an indispensable ingredient in ritual garments.
